top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Climb on AI Trade Optimism, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rose for a second day as enthusiasm over the artificial intelligence trade lifted equities ahead of earnings from tech megacaps and the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision. Crude oil rose.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Malicious apps prey on Russians’ anxiety about fuel prices, drone strikes
top_signals.summary: Cybercriminals are stuffing infostealer malware into bogus apps aimed at tracking gas prices, police activity, drone strikes and other information of concern to average Russians, researchers said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
